title: Saved heat comparison reused on a second durable run
summary: Normal Wright workspace and actual isolated engineering run. No mocked routes or physical action.

manualSteps.label: Open workspace
manualSteps.instruction: Open the isolated Heat-spreader comparison proof workspace.

manualSteps.label: Open workflows
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflows in the workspace activity bar.

manualSteps.label: Choose process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Workflow files, then Open workflow. Select the saved heat-spreader workflow.

manualSteps.label: Use process
manualSteps.instruction: Click Use saved process. Reopen the recorded run from its workspace link.

manualSteps.label: Reuse comparison
manualSteps.instruction: Open the same saved heat comparison with the second run selected. Inspect its one thermal-basis result and declared review, then reload. Leave the review waiting.

steps.label: Workspace offers Workflows
steps.purpose: Verify the normal workspace route with real API owners.
steps.expected: The workspace loads and offers Workflows.
steps.actual: Normal workspace and Workflows control visible.

steps.label: Workflows opens the editor
steps.summary: The established workflow editor is available inside the workspace.
steps.purpose: Verify actual workspace entry without mocking.

steps.label: Workflow file controls
steps.summary: The workspace offers named saved workflows.
steps.purpose: Use the existing saved file chooser.

steps.label: Choose the heat workflow
steps.summary: The exact accepted heat workflow appears in the saved files.
steps.purpose: Choose the engineering process by its saved file.
steps.expected: The accepted heat workflow is listed.

steps.label: Heat workflow diagram
steps.summary: The original heat assignment opens with its connected review, CAD and analysis stages.
steps.purpose: Keep authoring and working views on the accepted source.
steps.action: Choose the accepted heat workflow file.
steps.expected: Accepted heat diagram and working view action available.
steps.actual: Exact saved heat source is open.

steps.label: Shared working view
steps.summary: The process working interface opens in another Wright workspace tab.
steps.purpose: Verify shared inputs and readiness without creating another executor.
steps.expected: Common working view in a workspace tab.

steps.label: Attach the actual heat run
steps.summary: The working view reads the same isolated backend run.
steps.purpose: Use actual process state for interface composition.
steps.action: Reopen the recorded heat run link.
steps.expected: The common working view attaches without starting another run.

steps.label: Second run waits at its declared review
steps.summary: The new private heat run has produced its thermal basis and stopped at the accepted source�s declared review.
steps.purpose: Preserve deliberate interaction without opportunistic questions.
steps.action: Open the second durable run in the common working tab.
steps.expected: Actual waiting review with the second run�s exact subject.
steps.actual: Second run is waiting for the declared thermal-basis review.

steps.label: Unchanged saved comparison follows the new run
steps.summary: The saved compiled comparison displays only the new run�s basis result and exact waiting review.
steps.purpose: Prove saved bundle reuse rather than regenerating an interface.
steps.action: Open the same saved interface link with the second recorded run selected.
steps.expected: Same UI revision, second run�s waiting state and one current result.
steps.actual: Same saved revision connected; second run result and declared waiting review shown.

steps.label: Reload reconciles the waiting second run
steps.summary: Reloading the workspace restores the same saved comparison and the same unconsumed review.
steps.purpose: Keep view lifetime separate from durable execution.
steps.expected: No start, regeneration or review response from reload.
steps.actual: Same second-run waiting subject and single result restored.
